# logon.scr is all Rust (logon-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/logon-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# logon.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/logon-rust/src/logon/logon.rs)
add_cargo_module(logon logon-cargo logon.scr
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE logon-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
